replies.fb5e7c5615c993e65a70c23250528d7023383d97: {"points":[{"text":"All'inizio della partita, Northgate controlla il possesso palla al 100%, mentre Harbour non ha ancora avuto il pallone.","source":"recap:2"},{"text":"Il calcio d'inizio vede Northgate avviare l'azione attaccando da sinistra verso destra, impostando il ritmo della partita.","source":"commentary:1"},{"text":"Northgate mostra una manovra attenta sulla sinistra con giocatori chiave come Duval, Adeyemi e Kovacs nella metà campo avversaria.","source":"commentary:3"},{"text":"Un fallo di Costa di Harbour concede una punizione a Northgate, eseguita da Marsh, che costruisce l'attacco sulla sinistra.","source":"commentary:4,5,6"}]}

replies.6ad1c7faab2ad13bfd4251c8a30d4aee8cf33579: {"points":[{"text":"Northgate took the lead at 16 minutes through Marsh, assisted by Adeyemi, after dominating possession with 68% in the preceding five minutes, applying strong pressure on Harbour.","source":"recap:2"},{"text":"Possession at minute 16 was 59% for Northgate and 41% for Harbour, with Northgate maintaining superior control reflected in 4 shots (3 on target) versus Harbour's 5 shots (2 on target).","source":"recap:3"},{"text":"Northgate's build-up involved key contributions by Tanaka, Marsh, and Adeyemi, culminating in Marsh winning the ball in the final third and scoring the opening goal.","source":"goal_1 commentary"},{"text":"Both teams showed 89% pass accuracy at minute 16; Northgate had a higher number of passes (64) and slightly longer average pass length (15.5 m) than Harbour, aiding their offensive dominance.","source":"stats:16"}]}
replies.06304728ff50e421c1cd3fa5c69b54e2edf6fbd7: {"points":[{"text":"Marsh scores for Northgate at minute 16, assisted by Adeyemi, after Northgate had 68% of passes in the prior five minutes.","source":"recap:2"},{"text":"Before the goal, Northgate dominated possession with 59% compared to Harbour's 41%, and had more shots on target, 3 to 2.","source":"recap:3"},{"text":"Marsh's goal came following a period of control and build-up play from Northgate through Tanaka, Marsh, and Adeyemi into the final third.","source":"recap:2"}]}
replies.928beabd266ff75be0a6b91a2054611db0fff0a0: {"points":[{"text":"Il primo gol di Marsh per Northgate è arrivato al minuto 16 con un assist di Adeyemi, frutto di un predominio della squadra con il 68% dei passaggi nei cinque minuti precedenti.","source":"recap:2"},{"text":"Northgate ha dominato il possesso palla con il 59%, controllando la partita rispetto al 41% di Harbour.","source":"recap:3"},{"text":"Nonostante Harbour abbia effettuato più tiri (5 contro 4), Northgate ha avuto più precisione con 3 tiri in porta contro 2.","source":"recap:3"}]}
replies.ae8c91b1819844edd8be8f16902f7f3a04dc055a: {"points":[{"text":"Rossi's goal for Harbour leveled the score at 1:1 in the 52nd minute, assisted by Duarte with Harbour holding 63% possession in the five minutes leading up to the goal.","source":"recap:3"},{"text":"The build-up to Rossi's goal involved sustained pressure from Harbour, working the ball through Silva, Mbeki, and Duarte into the final third on the left flank.","source":"commentary:4"},{"text":"Harbour's recovery of possession in the opposition half by Silva was key leading to the goal, indicating strong midfield pressing and ball-winning.","source":"commentary:3"},{"text":"Match stats at 52 minutes showed balanced possession and shots, 50% each with Harbour slightly ahead in shots on target (7 to 5), reflecting their attacking pressure.","source":"recap:4"}]}
replies.f1f0d15058b7746c33e3fa9ba3bad9cde9d231b6: {"points":[{"text":"At minute 52, Harbour equalized through Rossi with an assist from Duarte, following a period where Harbour controlled 63% of the passes, indicating strong pressing before the goal.","source":"recap:3"},{"text":"Before the goal, Harbour dominated possession with 79% possession in recent plays, outpassing Northgate and showing superior pass accuracy (86% vs 83%).","source":"stats:52"},{"text":"Both teams had balanced overall possession at 50%, but Harbour edged slightly in shots on target (7 to 5) and total shots (13 to 10).","source":"recap:4"},{"text":"Northgate opened the scoring earlier with Marsh, assisted by Adeyemi, after holding 68% possession in the five minutes prior, showing both teams traded times of dominance.","source":"recap:2"}]}
replies.d803cb5009c99b96be3ac5ba350a109f05b9db1e: {"points":[{"text":"Il gol di Rossi al 52' ha portato l'Harbour al pareggio, favorito dal possesso predominante del 63% nei cinque minuti precedenti il gol.","source":"recap:3"},{"text":"Prima del gol, Harbour ha dominato la manovra sulla sinistra con Silva, Mbeki e Duarte, dimostrando organizzazione offensiva.","source":"goal_2 commentary:4"},{"text":"Silva ha giocato un ruolo chiave recuperando palla nella metà campo avversaria, contribuendo a creare l'occasione per il gol.","source":"goal_2 commentary:3"},{"text":"Il bilancio del match mostra un equilibrio nel possesso palla (50%-50%) e un leggero vantaggio di Harbour nei tiri (13 contro 10).","source":"recap:4"}]}
replies.fd692cfe6bd10354fd61df36e15e85864a3ee989: {"points":[{"text":"Al 52° minuto, Rossi segna per Harbour con assist di Duarte, riportando il risultato in parità dopo una fase in cui Harbour aveva il 63% dei passaggi.","source":"recap:3"},{"text":"Nei cinque minuti precedenti al gol di Rossi, Harbour ha controllato il gioco con il 63% del possesso palla.","source":"recap:3"},{"text":"La partita è equilibrata nel possesso palla (50% a 50%) e nei tiri in porta Harbour ha leggermente superato Northgate (13 tiri totali, 7 nello specchio).","source":"recap:4"},{"text":"Harbour ha costruito l'azione del gol avvicinandosi con manovre sulla destra e sinistra, fino all'ultimo terzo di campo.","source":"commentary:2,4"}]}
replies.6833b5926e789e2799085200a72fe31e4fb421a7: {"points":[{"text":"Marsh scored the decisive goal for Northgate at minute 78, assisted by Lindqvist, securing the lead for Northgate.","source":"recap:4"},{"text":"Before the goal, Northgate built their attack through the middle involving Tanaka, Lindqvist, and Kovacs, leading into the final third.","source":"commentary:5"},{"text":"At 78 minutes, possession was balanced with Harbour having a slight edge at 52%, but shots were nearly even: 16 for Northgate and 18 for Harbour.","source":"recap:5"},{"text":"Northgate's two goals came after periods of territorial dominance, indicated by their 68% passes before the first goal and effective buildup before the third goal.","source":"recap:2"}]}
